about.title: About Me
about.content:
I am a Senior Full-Stack Developer and Software Engineer with 4+ years building B2B SaaS web and mobile products. I write production code in React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Python/Django, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker, and CI/CD. React Native for iOS and Android.

Since February 2026 I also run my own studio (DMITRII KURILOV PR) — indie games in Godot and apps in React Native for PC, iOS, and Android.

At Anima (PropTech) I build and ship software across the full stack. I joined in 2023, grew into team lead, and now work with a team of 7 on microservices platforms for smart offices and business centers. Shipped mobile apps to the App Store and Google Play, kiosk apps for wall panels, and on-premise rollouts at 5 enterprise client sites. I still code daily: REST APIs, frontend features, mobile screens, GitLab CI/CD pipelines.

Stack I use in production: React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, React Native, Redux, MobX, Node.js, Express.js, Python, Django, REST APIs, microservices, PostgreSQL, Redis, MongoDB, Docker, GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions, Nginx, WebSocket, system architecture.

Open to new opportunities as a Full-Stack Developer or Engineering Team Lead.
Portfolio: https://wantid.github.io/galaxy-portfolio/

System Architect & Development Team Lead - Joined in 2023 to shape a new B2B product. Designed architecture and core processes, built React.js and Express.js prototypes, and worked with an outsourced team while the company prepared to move development in-house.

From 2024 I lead the in-house team (7 people). We shipped a smart-office booking platform: 2 React Native apps in the App Store and Google Play, 2 Android kiosk apps for wall panels (no Google services), GitLab Enterprise with CI/CD, and on-premise rollouts at 5 enterprise client sites.

Designed two B2B ecosystems on microservices: Smart Office (live) and Smart Business Center (in development).

I act as technical consultant on architecture decisions across the company.

Achievement: Took the product from early prototypes and outsourcing to an in-house team and production deployments at enterprise clients.

С февраля 2026 веду своё ИП (DMITRII KURILOV PR) — инди-игры на Godot и приложения на React Native для PC, iOS и Android.

В Anima (PropTech) работаю full-stack: разрабатываю и выпускаю продукт. Пришёл в 2023, вырос до team lead и сейчас веду команду из 7 человек на микросервисных платформах для умных офисов и бизнес-центров. Выпустил мобильные приложения в App Store и Google Play, kiosk-приложения для настенных панелей и on-premise внедрения на 5 enterprise-площадках. Каждый день пишу код: REST API, фронтенд, мобильные экраны, GitLab CI/CD пайплайны.

Стек в продакшене: React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, React Native, Redux, MobX, Node.js, Express.js, Python, Django, REST APIs, microservices, PostgreSQL, Redis, MongoDB, Docker, GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions, Nginx, WebSocket, системная архитектура.

about.title: O meni
about.content:
Ja sam Senior Full-Stack programer i Software Engineer sa 4+ godine iskustva u B2B SaaS veb i mobilnim proizvodima. Pišem produkcijski kod u React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Python/Django, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker i CI/CD. React Native za iOS i Android.

Od februara 2026. vodim sopstveni PR (DMITRII KURILOV PR) — indie igre u Godot-u i aplikacije u React Native-u za PC, iOS i Android.

U Anima (PropTech) radim full-stack: gradim i isporučujem softver. Došao sam 2023, napao do team lead-a i sada radim sa timom od 7 ljudi na mikroservisnim platformama za pametne ofise i poslovne centre. Objavio mobilne aplikacije na App Store i Google Play, kiosk aplikacije za zidne panele i on-premise implementacije na 5 enterprise lokacija. Svakodnevno pišem kod: REST API, frontend, mobilne ekrane, GitLab CI/CD pipeline-ove.

Stek u produkciji: React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, React Native, Redux, MobX, Node.js, Express.js, Python, Django, REST APIs, microservices, PostgreSQL, Redis, MongoDB, Docker, GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions, Nginx, WebSocket, sistemska arhitektura.

Učestvujem kao tehnički konsultant za arhitektonske odluke u kompaniji.
